source: segmentation (Blender render, background replaced by white)
pixel_convention: x right, y down, full-resolution pixels; all values in px and s, no metric scale

camera.motion: static (background median is sharp; chair pixels identical across frames apart from segmentation edge flicker)
camera.perspective_notes: Background is pure white (no ground/horizon). Chairs are in two rows: back row appears ~145 px tall, front row ~167 px tall, so there is mild perspective/depth difference between rows. The cat (feet y~918-925) and float (bottom y~1010-1018) are lower in the image, i.e. nearer the camera than the chairs. Apparent sizes of both moving objects stay constant over the clip (float mask 158x125-133 px all frames; cat ~105x72 px), so each moves at roughly constant depth, parallel to the image plane.
